# anthropic_workspace_members (Data Source)

List all members of the workspace.

Requires an Admin API key: set `api_key` in the provider block or the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable. OAuth bearer tokens (`auth_token`) are not used.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_workspace_members" "example" {
  workspace_id = "wrkspc_xxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the Workspace.

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes Set) List of Workspace Members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `user_id` (String) ID of the user who is a member of the Workspace.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the Workspace to which the member belongs.
- `workspace_role` (String) Role of the new Workspace Member.
